purpose: Main fix run combining the three winning single-variable 2k pilots against the measured M6 motion collapse: (A) 16-frame generation blocks (pilot speed .507 vs control .300), (D) motion-weighted flow loss alpha 1 (pilot speed .383), (F) foreground-alpha-weighted flow loss 4 (pilot speed .327, real .314, control-level TVR). The losing pilots (history-noise .213, 2.4s history .187) both intervened on the history side; all three winners reallocate training signal toward moving figure content, so they are combined. Budget follows Jin's much-longer-training directive (raised again 2026-08-22 after watching early previews): 100k steps, matching the h8 100k convergence control budget for a like-for-like comparison, with predeclared n=64 milestone evaluations at 2k/5k/10k/20k/40k/60k/80k/100k. Supersedes the 40k declaration (configs/m6_protocol_v8_combined_h16_40k.json), whose run was stopped at ~7.5k steps before any milestone evaluation existed. Claim limit: single seed; milestone curve diagnoses whether the combination escapes the h8 Pareto front, not a final ranking.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.
